profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Yelp
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experience in Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Deep Learning research and engineering. Work previously included: designing and building data pipeline architecture and AI systems, ML model development and deployment, defining and researching novel problem spaces, and formulating solutions for other industry demands. Currently focused on building secure and reliable production backend infrastructure for big data. Strong background in Mathematics (Analysis, Abstract Algebra, Probability, etc.) from my time at the University of British Columbia during my undergraduate studies.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Formerly Database Reliability Engineering team:
- Led 25+ team migration with 80+ engineers from legacy ORM (EZSQL, EZAlchemy) to SQLAlchemy. Created runbooks for various models, logic, and usages. Developed and tested LLM migration workflows to migrate models, logic, and usages (some models with 100's usages).

Currently Streamhouse team:
- Designed, developed, and tested refresh infrastructure for Streamhouse (Flink MySQL CDC + Paimon in S3).
- Migrating Kafka streams to Paimon for Data Lake, Cassandra, Spark, and other Consumer Sinks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Database Reliability Engineering Team:
- Designed, built, and tested refresh infrastructure for Debezium, MySQL CDC source connector.
- Assisted leads with unblocking migration from legacy MySQL CDC source connector, replication Handler to Debezium including determining feature parity, stabilizing new infrastructure, and migrating 90% of connections.
- Built monitoring and alerting for Vitess Kubernetes deployment, including Prometheus scraping, Grafana Dashboards, and PagerDuty alerting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Database Reliability Engineering Team
- Project Lead for MySQL, Vitess, and SQLAlchemy upgrades and deployments
- Automation systems for Vitess workflows configs and deployment, rotating MySQL hosts, etc.
- Upgrade infrastructure (backups, bootstrapping, etc.) to support MySQL 8 roll out
- Migartion of MySQL monitoring + dashboards from SignalFX to Prometheus
Technologies: MySQL, ProxySQL, ZooKeeper, Vitess, and related tools and technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer (Stream Processing)
positions.description:
Stream Processing Team
- Designed and implemented benchmarking for various throughput and state size demands for Apache Beam pipelines running in the Yelp streaming infrastructure 
- Deployed Kew task queue service to new AWS environment in order to support migration from ReviewBoard to Git pull requests for Yelp internal repositories 
- Built unit test infrastructure for Apache Beam java and python sdk at Yelp
- Refactored Stream SQL service to support microsecond timestamp accuracy

Languages and Libraries: java, python, scala, Apache Flink, Apache Beam, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Docker, Apache Kafka, and Paasta

positions.title: Founder
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Decision intelligence platform for trading card grading arbitrage

Built and iterated on a trading card analytics product, evolving it from a cross-platform pricing tool into a focused decision engine for identifying profitable grading opportunities.

v2 Relaunch (2026):
* Reframed product from broad pricing/search → high-signal recommendations (“what to buy raw and grade for profit”)
* Re-architected to web-first stack (Next.js, Flask, Supabase/Postgres), replacing mobile-heavy v1
* Built ETL pipeline integrating Sports Card Pro + PriceCharting with normalization + consistency scoring
* Developed recommendation system using price spread, comp variance, and ROI/confidence scoring
* Shifted UX to curated weekly outputs to reduce noise and drive action

Analytics & Monetization:
* Implemented end-to-end funnel tracking (landing → preview → paywall → subscription)
* Instrumented events to analyze engagement, drop-off, and conversion behavior
* Used funnel + cohort insights to iterate on paywall design, preview limits, and pricing ($15–$19/mo)
* Optimized for fast weekly iteration loops driven by user behavior

v1:
* Built iOS (Swift), Android (Java/Kotlin), and web app with Flask + SQLite backend
* Aggregated pricing for raw and graded cards (PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC) with ROI tooling

Impact:
* 2k+ iOS downloads; 100–200 MAU sustained ~12 months
* Transitioned product from analytics dashboard → monetizable decision system

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
- Assisted leadership with founding the Machine Learning and Data Science org as the first ML engineer hired, including assisting with hiring and on boarding process of a diverse pool of talented engineers and researchers
- Authored patent and grant applications for novel machine learning research
- Collaborated with researchers to develop novel computer vision architectures
- Developed, trained, tested and optimized models and algorithms in computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning. These models included: human pose estimation, image and video classification/recognition, object detection/localization/tracking, and optical flow estimation
- Designed and built systems for experimentation and evaluation in order to empirically test and compare various models by utilizing applicable evaluation metrics for the given problem
- Implemented, trained and deployed ML production systems locally or cloud-based
- Performed data collection for training ML models, which included designing and implementing pipeline architectures for data preprocessing, manipulation, duplication, and post processing 

Languages and Libraries:
- c++, keras, html5, lime, mxnet, numpy, pandas, python, opencv, scikit-learn, seaborn, sonnet, tensorboard, and tensorflow

positions.title: Junior IT Support Analyst
positions.description:
- Supported faculty and research groups within the Psychology Department with computer, network, security, storage, and communication systems
- Assembled custom computer builds for user's specified needs
- Built, maintained, and troubleshooted computer and software programs for a variety of use cases
